recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Hex Oracle Siege as a single-page browser game using vanilla HTML, CSS, and Canvas. Preserve the source falling-target tap arcade mechanics: targets spawn at the top, fall downward, rotate, and are removed on tap; normal targets score +10, rare bonus targets score +50, hazards remove one life, missed non-hazard targets remove one life, and three lost lives show a final-score restart screen. Rebuild all presentation as a magical Clash Royale inspired arena ruled by an evil AI assistant. Use procedural towers, runes, a central Dark Oracle console face, royal violet/gold/mana colors, chunky mobile HUD cards, Hex Trophy scoring, Firewall Ward lives, mystical audio from approved catalogs, compact feedback cards, and mobile-safe tap/click handling.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first falling-target tap arcade game
- objective: tap falling non-hazard targets before they leave the bottom of the canvas; build score from +10 normal targets and +50 bonus targets
- input model: pointer/tap on the canvas; restart button uses native click/tap; missed empty taps have no penalty
- core loop: spawn target, target falls with gravity-scaled speed, player taps target, score/particles/feedback update, spawn rate accelerates gradually, missed non-hazard targets cost one life, three lost lives ends the run
- fail/friction state: tapping a hazard costs a life; missing normal or bonus falling targets costs a life; game over shows final score and restart CTA

## Protected Mechanics
- Canvas update/render loop with frame-delta timing.
- Random target spawn position, size, type mix, fall speed, and rotation.
- Score semantics: normal target +10, bonus target +50, hazard target no points and costs one life.
- Life semantics: three lives; non-hazard miss or hazard tap removes one life; zero lives enters game over.
- Input semantics: pointer/tap hit-testing against falling targets; empty taps do nothing; restart resets run.

## Remixed Target
Hex Oracle Siege reframes the same loop as a magical Clash Royale inspired arena where an evil AI assistant/oracle rains command sigils, elixir crowns, and cursed prompts toward the player firewall. The player counters falling commands by tapping them, earns Hex Trophies, preserves Firewall Wards, and loses when the Dark Assistant overwhelms the arena.

focal_identity: evil AI assistant as magical oracle
